description: Create a wiki page from Markdown in a space you can write to. Hangs off the space home page unless you name a parent (by 'parentId', or by 'parentTitle' within the same space). Returns the new page id and its URL. Mention someone as [@Their Name](user:username) — on a wiki page that is the form that notifies, not the [~username] used in issues; link another page as [text](page:Title) or [text](page:SPACE/Title). A ```anim block (a scene as JSON the reader's browser plays — product_help topic 'anim') is read at once: the answer's 'anims' says, per block, whether it plays or every problem with where it stands. Answers with 'notified' (who this actually reaches) and 'unresolvedMentions' (what looked like a mention and reached nobody, each with a reason) — a wrong handle is stored as written and never refused, so that list is the only sign it did not land.

labels.description: Labels to set, space or comma separated. Stored in lower case, except a label starting with '$', which is kept exactly as written. The label 'template' offers the page as a template: people then make pages from it.

markdown.description: Page body as Markdown, which also carries $…$ / $$…$$ LaTeX formulas and the wiki's macros on a line of their own — {toc}, {children}, {info} … {info}, {expand:title=…} … {expand}. A theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, conjecture or question is a block of its own — ::: theorem {#thm:label status=computer number=5.8 title="…"} on its line, the statement, then ::: — read into the project's register of claims at the save (list_claims); 'claims' in the answer says which.

parentId.description: Parent page id. Omit to hang the page off the space home page.

parentTitle.description: Parent page title, as an alternative to 'parentId'. Must be a page in the same space.

spaceKey.description: Space key, e.g. 'PM'. Every project has exactly one space, keyed like the project.

templateId.description: Make the page from a template: the id of a page of the same space that carries the label 'template' (search_wiki finds them by that label). The new page starts as the template's text and its other labels; 'markdown', when you send it too, wins.

title.description: Page title. Must be unique within the space — the title is how pages are addressed here.

name: create_wiki_page
